message: The other day, as the winds picked up outside and the sky turned a bit ominous, I found myself rummaging through the closet for our old board games. You know, the ones that don’t require Wi-Fi or batteries? We spent the evening laughing over a game of Scrabble, with only the sound of the storm outside to keep us company. It was a lovely reminder that sometimes the best entertainment is a little low-tech fun. What’s your go-to activity when the weather keeps you indoors? 🎲
